exclusions.reason: Draft-04 tells 1.0 from 1, and 2020-12 and draft-07 can't: they give both the same verdict. Draft-04 rejects 1.0 as an integer, so {"type": "integer"} accepts it once emitted. Under not and oneOf that integer check flips, so 1.0 has to stay accepted, which means 1 must be accepted too or the emitted schema would reject what SafeParse accepts. So not is left out, with anything else it held, and oneOf becomes anyOf. The verdict is right before emitting, and it only ever moves towards accepting.
